name: LIBERO Franka Emika Panda simulation geometry and assembly
description: Self-contained URDF (panda.urdf) and every referenced binary STL visual and collision mesh of the simulated LIBERO (robosuite MuJoCo) Franka Emika Panda arm and PandaGripper, preserving relative directories. Simulation-only model; live camera and scene calibration come from observations.
